## Scientific/formal voice

A Consent Record is attributable evidence that a participant gave or withdrew consent for one named processing purpose when the approved protocol uses consent as that purpose's lawful basis, bound to exact notice wording, scope and time.

### Notation

No notation is required.

### Boundary conditions

- A Purpose Choice may be recorded even when consent is not the selected lawful basis; it must not be relabeled as a Consent Record.
- Challenge participation does not imply research, model-training or employment-use consent.

### Testable conditions

None declared.

## Plain-language voice

Evidence that a person made a specific informed choice for a specific approved purpose when consent is the selected basis.
